sentences.text: 5. A five year old girl is said to have been raped and then strangulated to death.
6. The mother of the deceased had informed the father of the deceased on telephone that the victim is not be found for quite some time.
Later, her dead- body was recovered.
The mother of the deceased had informed that Rabindra Singh and the appellant had been playing with the deceased in the evening.
When they were questioned, they did not reply but agreed to look for the victim.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.816 of 2023(5) dt.11-11-2024 7.

While canvassing for suspension of sentence of the appellant, it has been urged before us that during the course of trial, it came to the light that co- convict/Rabindra Singh had purchased a land of the neighbourhood over which the informant of this case also had staked his claim.
The informant has also admitted of enmity because of land dispute with co- convict/Rabindra's family.
Nobody claims to have seen the occurrence or seen any part of the occurrence, which would point an accusing finger towards the appellant.
The appellant, it has been urged, is a rank outsider and only because he had visited his friend/co- convict/Rabindra, suspicion has been raised against him as well.
Apart from this, it has been argued that there is nothing on record to indicate that the appellant had participated in the occurrence.
8. Mr. Satya Narayan Prasad, the learned APP has informed us that the appeal of co-convict/Rabindra, viz., Cr. Appeal (DB) No. 653 of 2023 is pending Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.816 of 2023(5) dt.11-11-2024 hearing before this Bench.
9. We do not think it appropriate to enlarge the appellant on bail now.
10. However, this case requires an urgent hearing.
Let this appeal be listed along with Cr. Appeal (DB) No. 653 of 2023 for hearing within twenty-five cases in the week commencing from 07 th of January, 2025.
11. The prayer for suspension of sentence of the appellant is rejected for the present.
(Ashutosh Kumar, J) (Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) manoj/krishna- U T Ruksad @ Rukshad vs The State Of Bihar on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53760330/
